trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself. There is no separate task for this one: it unlocks automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat the rest of this list as the real checklist and let this be the victory lap at the end of it.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet. Expect this to sit deep in ultra-rare territory for a long time — plausibly under 1% of players for months.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. Start the story and play through the introduction; this pops before you have any real freedom to roam, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Chapter trophies are handed out automatically at each chapter's closing scene and the campaign is linear, so simply keep playing and this lands on its own.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Follow the story markers through the chapter; like the other chapter trophies, this one is awarded automatically when the chapter wraps up.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the campaign. Awarded at the end of the chapter during normal story progression — no side conditions, no collectibles, just keep the story moving.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Another automatic story unlock: push through the chapter's missions and it pops at the conclusion, exactly like the chapters before it.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This gold marks the end of the campaign and should pop as the credits roll. The game lets you keep playing after the ending, so you do not need to finish any side content before taking the finale on.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet. A story-completion gold usually ends up uncommon rather than rare once players settle in.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run. It arrives in sequence as you work through the campaign, so it unlocks in passing rather than needing a detour.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.targetLabel: Complete the mission: The Cartel Heist
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, one of the campaign's big set-piece jobs. Play it when the story offers it and the trophy is awarded for finishing the mission, however messy the getaway gets.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play during the story. It sits on the main campaign path, so it unlocks automatically in story order.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. It is part of the main story path, which means it cannot be skipped over or locked out — finish the mission and the trophy follows.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a story mission built around the airport authority. Play through it when it appears in the campaign and the trophy is yours at the mission's end.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.targetLabel: Complete the mission: Operation Savage Glory
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Another campaign mission trophy that arrives in story order — no preparation beyond reaching it in the narrative.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.targetLabel: percent on the in-game completion tracker
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion tracker. This is the long haul of the platinum: story missions, stranger strands, hobbies, collectibles and odd jobs all feed the percentage. Treat the in-game tracker as your source of truth and sweep it category by category instead of chasing random activities, saving a final map-and-menu audit for whatever percentage points refuse to appear.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet. A 100%-completion gold is a serious time sink, so expect it to stay rare for a long while.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the jumps and stunt events scattered all over Leonida. There are far more stunt locations than you need, so work them into normal travel instead of grinding one ramp for hours: clear every stunt you pass on the way to something else and the counter climbs on its own.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You do not need to win, finish or even enjoy them — starting an activity registers the type. If your count seems stuck one short, you have almost certainly walked past one of the less obvious pastimes without ever starting it.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.targetLabel: Shooting Range challenges with a gold medal
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each weapon category's target patterns, raise your shooting stats first if a category keeps beating you, and replay challenges individually — only the gold medal matters, not one flawless run through the whole range.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. One win per location is enough — no gold times required. Use a first attempt to learn the racing line through the gates, then push properly on the second run.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not add to the count, so keep moving to fresh race markers around the map. Any vehicle class counts, as long as each win is a distinct event.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the challenge, use a practice catch or two to learn the reeling timing, then out-fish him in the head-to-head — the trophy pops the moment you win it.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Cabinets sit in bars and arcades around the map; pick the shortest game you can find, play it through to completion once, and you are done.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission, which means finishing his whole stranger strand. Work through every Andy encounter as it appears on the map — the trophy is for closing the strand out, not just for meeting him once.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand by completing his last mission. Keep clearing his map markers whenever a new one surfaces and the finale will unlock at the end of the chain.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Follow his stranger strand from the first meeting all the way to the last job and this pops as the strand concludes.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of encounters with the same character, so finish strands one at a time to keep track. Handy shortcut: the individual 'final mission' trophies elsewhere in this list each mark one strand completed, so they double as your progress record for this silver.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission to close out his strand. Clear his encounters in order as they appear and the trophy unlocks with the finale.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Work his strand through to its conclusion and the trophy unlocks alongside the finale.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — but handle one of them with care. The balcony meditation tied to Lucia during Chapter 1 is widely flagged by launch-week players as possibly missable: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so if that moment passes, there may be no way back for it on that save. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the moment it is available, then sweep the remaining spots in free roam whenever you pass them.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet. If the Chapter 1 spot really is missable, expect this to become one of the list's notorious bronzes.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Progress Bret's strand until the special hunt is offered, then track the animal down — a patient approach and one clean, well-placed shot make the encounter far easier than a running gun battle through the brush.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are tucked away in shops, bars and landmarks across the state. Focus on finishing three sets completely instead of scattering pickups across every set at once, and sweep district by district so you always know which set a new card belongs to.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK photo spots at 100 locations. These marked viewpoints and landmarks are everywhere, so photograph each one as you pass through its area while doing other tasks — the count builds quietly, and only the last stretch should need a dedicated sweep.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the short scored tasks dotted around the world — quick, varied and plentiful. Dip into them whenever one is nearby and you will pass 50 long before the endgame without ever grinding for them specifically.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.targetLabel: 4-star wanted level lost with partner present
trophies.guide: With your partner riding with you, build up a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it and escape. Your partner has to be present for both halves: cause enough trouble together to reach four stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain away completely.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without letting your Wanted Level fully drop in between. Plan a tight route of three nearby stores beforehand, keep moving between them, and never hide long enough for the heat to reset until the third robbery is done.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting into a model you have never driven before registers it, so steal broadly as you travel — varied city traffic makes the early count painless, and rarer classes can be hunted in their usual haunts later.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.targetLabel: enemies downed in one Combat Focus
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single Combat Focus activation. Wait for a crowded firefight, position yourself with several targets in view before triggering Focus, then sweep the group in one pass. Story shootouts with clustered enemies are the most reliable setups for this.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, leave the airport in a way the airport never intended, such as taking an aircraft out without clearance. Get your hands on something that flies and depart on your own schedule.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. The description points squarely at the Rhino tank, but no reliable method has been verified — the trackers list this trophy without a confirmed trigger. Do not burn hours on guessed methods; if it pops for you unexpectedly, make a note of exactly what you were doing, because the community is still piecing this one together.
trophies.rarity: No public rate and no confirmed method yet — rarity is meaningless until the trigger is known.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms tripped, no witnesses raising the alert. Case the store first, move fast once you are at the cases, and be out the door before anyone clocks what happened — if the detection meter fills, abandon the attempt and try again clean.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.targetLabel: bank vaults robbed with a clean escape
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault jobs are the heavy scores, so gear up properly and plan your exit route before you start rather than improvising it with the alarm ringing. A robbery that ends in a bust does not count — only clean getaways move the counter.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.targetLabel: armored truck robbed with a clean escape
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush the truck on a quiet stretch of road, crack it open fast, take the cash and vanish before the response arrives. One successful truck job is all this asks for.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you physically visit each district, town and island, and most of it opens up naturally through story and side content. Near the end, compare your map against the region list and road-trip whatever grey patches remain.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.targetLabel: gangs whose illegal operation you have robbed
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang is enough — spread your hits across every gang on the list instead of wiping out a single gang's whole network.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. The description suggests having a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach, but the exact drink, bar or interaction has not been verified by any tracker yet. Trying the obvious beachfront bars costs little, but treat every step-by-step 'method' circulating this early as a guess, not a solution.
trophies.rarity: No public rate and no confirmed method yet — rarity is meaningless until the trigger is known.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. The description describes smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom 'in classic style' — a wink at a famous moment from the series' past — but which showroom, which vehicle and what precisely triggers it are all unverified. Do not follow confident-looking solutions yet; none of them are confirmed.
trophies.rarity: No public rate and no confirmed method yet — rarity is meaningless until the trigger is known.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.targetLabel: bowling game finished at Kolt & Associates
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Head to the alley, start a game and — this is the 'follow-through' part — see it through to the final frame rather than quitting out mid-game.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.targetLabel: No published counter — tied to a partnership moment
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague and no counter is published for this one. It appears to be tied to a shared moment between the two protagonists, so play the story and spend time on partner activities in free roam; if it pops, it will most likely be during cooperative antics with your partner rather than anything you can grind directly.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks this as a counter that runs to 500. Dialogue options and decision prompts throughout the story and side content all feed it, so a full playthrough should carry you most of the way. If you come up short near the end, stranger encounters and interactive prompts are the richest remaining source.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. 'Second time's the charm' hints at failing at something and succeeding on the retry, but nobody has verified which activity it belongs to. Do not deliberately sabotage your own progress chasing guesses — park this one until a confirmed method exists.
trophies.rarity: No public rate and no confirmed method yet — rarity is meaningless until the trigger is known.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. The description suggests witnessing some kind of strange phenomenon somewhere out in Leonida, but no location, event or condition has been verified by any tracker. Keep an eye out during odd encounters in remote areas, and treat early 'found it' claims with healthy suspicion.
trophies.rarity: No public rate and no confirmed method yet — rarity is meaningless until the trigger is known.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch. Despite the bowling name, the description is about knocking someone down with a melee drive-by. The exact setup — which vehicle, what speed, what kind of target — has not been verified, so experiment cheaply if you try it at all, and do not trust confident guides this early.
trophies.rarity: No public rate and no confirmed method yet — rarity is meaningless until the trigger is known.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 worth of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from scores and robberies; instead of sitting on them, pass them through your laundering contacts as they come in and the cumulative total will cross a quarter of a million in the course of a full playthrough.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Clothing, weapons, vehicle work and services all feed the same pot, so ordinary play gets you most of the way there — a late-game shopping spree with a healthy bank balance finishes it off.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages come up for purchase as you progress through the game; once your balance can take the hit, sweep the property listings and buy out whatever is left in one pass.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.targetLabel: vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it through the app instead of just driving off in it — ten registrations and this one is done.
trophies.rarity: No public rarity rate yet — the game has only just launched, so any ranking would be a guess.
